## Highlights

- Republished beta5 with a desktop shutdown fix: the window close button now exits normally, including after focus loss or while an account dialog is open, and still runs the final pause/save callbacks. Downloads and `SHA256SUMS` have been replaced with the corrected builds.
- Fixed Poppy losing ability input after drum contact, and restored face changes during flight, aiming and ability use, including costume skins.
- Included the complete original platform UI artwork and notification resources in the external data package.
- Improved original resource decoding, masked sprites, image lifetimes, bitmap fonts and account text rendering.
- Preserved native animation Clip and Timeline identity and callback ordering, and reduced unnecessary animation-event allocation before key changes.
- Expanded browser account, rating, screenshot sharing and local leaderboard flows; added ZIP save backups, touch and focus fixes, and light/dark/system themes.
- Release desktop builds start directly without a CLI. Debug and optimized `diagnostic` builds retain developer options.
- Desktop resources remain external. Each platform package contains one game executable plus `runtime/data`; the game does not embed or automatically extract resources.
- Archived automatic playthrough scripts. Active regressions retain representative gameplay, restart, failure/retry and save restoration.

## Downloads and startup

Five desktop packages are provided: macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64 and Linux x86_64/ARM64. Unix packages use `.tar.gz`; Windows packages use `.zip`. Each includes the game program, external resources, README, license and build information. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS`.

Extract the complete package and start `stella-app` (`stella-app.exe` on Windows). Keep `runtime/data` beside the program. Saves and local service state remain in the sibling `runtime/appdata` directory. Existing saves are not automatically migrated; retain or back up that directory when replacing an installation.

Windows builds use the GUI subsystem and static CRT. Linux needs the system desktop/audio libraries and supported graphics drivers. Developer CLI commands require a debug or `diagnostic` build.

## Browser edition

The corresponding browser build is deployed to [GitHub Pages](https://lambdaed1th.github.io/angrybirdsstella-rehost/) after release publication. The launcher includes all 11 original languages, account and local leaderboard views, themes and save backup/import. Progress remains in the current browser; export a backup before clearing site data.

## Validation and status

The release source passed strict Clippy for macOS ARM64, Windows x86_64/ARM64, Linux x86_64/ARM64 and the Emscripten browser target. Local regression coverage passed 1976 workspace tests and 345 release desktop tests; two existing default-ignored tests remain unchanged. Desktop termination regressions cover focus loss, account overlays, final reward persistence and save errors. External-resource packaging tests and per-file resource hashes were checked using isolated data.

This remains a beta rehost, not a declaration of complete native parity. Exact rendering, animation, physics and platform behavior continue to be verified. Retired online services and real platform payments are not restored; local providers are substitutes. Telepods uses code injection rather than camera scanning. No automatic playthrough implementation is included.

Repository-authored code is AGPL-3.0-or-later. Original game resources retain their respective rights and are not relicensed by the project's source-code license.
